name: Bellis IV
description: Bellis IV, also known as Bellis Four, was a planet in the Bellis system of Demetras sector. Prior to the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Bellis IV was the sight of a conflict but was ultimately freed, in large part due to the actions of the Jedi Ngani Zho.
